title: Protest in N.R. Pura over elephant attack

ai.summary: Farmers in N.R. Pura town staged a protest demanding a permanent solution to human-elephant conflict after a farmer died in an elephant attack.

facts.claim: Farmers’ organisations in N.R. Pura taluk of Chikkamagaluru district observed a bandh in N.R. Pura town on Thursday to condemn the death of a farmer in an elephant attack.
facts.quote: Farmers’ organisations in N.R. Pura taluk of Chikkamagaluru district observed a bandh in N.R. Pura town on Thursday to condemn the death of a farmer in an elephant attack.

facts.claim: Residents of the taluk also staged a protest, demanding a permanent solution to the human-elephant conflict.
facts.quote: Residents of the taluk also staged a protest, demanding a permanent solution to the human-elephant conflict.

facts.claim: Krishnamurthi, 53, a farmer from Hennangi village, was attacked by a wild elephant on Wednesday evening while searching for his cattle in the forest area.
facts.quote: Krishnamurthi, 53, a farmer from Hennangi village, was attacked by a wild elephant on Wednesday evening while searching for his cattle in the forest area.

facts.claim: The bandh call drew a good response, with many business establishments remaining closed during the morning hours in support of the protest.
facts.quote: The bandh call drew a good response, with many business establishments remaining closed during the morning hours in support of the protest.

facts.claim: The farmers demanded the construction of a railway barricade to prevent wild elephants from entering human habitations.
facts.quote: The farmers demanded the construction of a railway barricade to prevent wild elephants from entering human habitations.

facts.claim: They also objected to Excise Minister K.M. Shivalinge Gowda’s statement that problem elephants in Hassan district would be driven to the Bhadra Wildlife Sanctuary.
facts.quote: They also objected to Excise Minister K.M. Shivalinge Gowda’s statement that problem elephants in Hassan district would be driven to the Bhadra Wildlife Sanctuary.

facts.claim: Urging the State government to withdraw the decision, they said the conflict must be addressed within Chikkamagaluru district itself, in the interest of its people.
facts.quote: Urging the State government to withdraw the decision, they said the conflict must be addressed within Chikkamagaluru district itself, in the interest of its people.

facts.claim: MLA T.D. Raje Gowda, Deputy Commissioner Bhanwar Singh Meena, Superintendent of Police Jitendra Kumar Dayama and others met the protesters.
facts.quote: MLA T.D. Raje Gowda, Deputy Commissioner Bhanwar Singh Meena, Superintendent of Police Jitendra Kumar Dayama and others met the protesters.

facts.claim: Mr. Raje Gowda said he had met Forest Minister Ramalinga Reddy and urged him not to drive wild elephants to the Bhadra Wildlife Sanctuary, as the sanctuary already has a high elephant population.
facts.quote: Mr. Raje Gowda said he had met Forest Minister Ramalinga Reddy and urged him not to drive wild elephants to the Bhadra Wildlife Sanctuary, as the sanctuary already has a high elephant population.

facts.claim: Mr. Meena said he would convene meetings on forest-related issues regularly and address them in a timely manner. He added that the Forest Minister had convened a meeting to discuss human-elephant conflict.
facts.quote: Mr. Meena said he would convene meetings on forest-related issues regularly and address them in a timely manner. He added that the Forest Minister had convened a meeting to discuss human-elephant conflict.

ai.background_note: Farmers in N.R. Pura taluk of Chikkamagaluru district staged a protest after a farmer died in an elephant attack, demanding a railway barricade to prevent wild elephants from entering human habitations and urging the state government to address the human-elephant conflict within Chikkamagaluru district.
